title: ArUco Studio: the functionality we want, and the tests
about: Two separate lists, as Zach asked: 'features' is the functionality we want; 'tests' is how we check it.
Every feature and test starts as 'planned'. A builder sets a feature to 'built' and a test to 'passing' / 'failing' with the command that shows it.
'ref_ids' and 'ref_tests' point at REF's docs/aruco_spec.json (cad-exporter, c8216ff) so nothing is lost in the move. REF test ids are quoted verbatim (EX-MARK-1, G0.3, ...).
'milestone' says which build (docs/PLAN.md M1, M2, M2b, M3, M4, M5) owns it. An empty milestone is deferred or the orchestrator's.

Reviewed 2026-10-16 (PLAN.md section 6): entries added by the review are ST-RESTRUCTURE, ST-JO-MATHS, ST-FACES, ST-GUIDES, ST-SPEC-CHECK, ST-UI-TARGET and the tests ST-T-GOLDEN-1, ST-T-RESTRUCTURE-1, ST-T-JO-1, ST-T-PLAN-5, ST-T-PLAN-6, ST-T-SCENE-2, ST-T-VERIFY-3, ST-T-VERIFY-4, ST-T-UI-11, ST-T-UI-12.
M1 (2026-10-16): the M1 builder set the statuses of M1's features and tests, each with a 'result' (what shows it); a test still 'planned' has a 'reason'. Numbers: docs/status/M1.md.
M2 (2026-10-16): the M2 builder (plan, scene, verify, exports, server: PLAN M2 + M2b in one run) set the statuses of those features and tests the same way. Numbers: docs/status/M2.md.

M3 (2026-10-16): the M3 builder (the Studio web app, with the preset Library brought forward from M5) set the statuses of the studio features and tests the same way; e2e tests live in ROOT/e2e. Numbers: docs/status/M3.md.

M3 audit (2026-10-16): the fixes of the post-M3 audit set the PDF sheet built, the core's purity test passing, the Fusion adapter features partial (skeleton on the fake adsk; gates F1-F8 pending) with their tests passing on the fake, and added ST-T-AUDIT-1 / 2. Numbers: docs/status/AUDIT.md and docs/status/M4.md.
Feature statuses: planned, built, partial, deferred. Test statuses: planned, passing, failing, skipped.

Final verification (2026-10-16, about 21:00): every status checked against a clean run of tools/check.py (OK in 362 s: adapters 97, core 7,245 + 4 skipped, plan 193, scene 7, server 35, verify 104, studio build + vitest, e2e 19) and --trace (missing 0). ST-T-RUN-1 set passing from that run; every planned or deferred entry carries a reason. The record: docs/STATUS.md and reports/status.html.

Waves 1-3 and the 2026-10-17 audit (the orchestrator): the M6a, M8a, M8b1, M8c and M8b2 entries added with their tests; the M6 note's ST-HOLES is ST-HOLES-RULE here (ST-HOLES is the older screws-and-holes item); ST-UI-TARGET deferred (replaced by ST-UI-SKETCH); the audit added ST-FROZEN-PRESETS, ST-LABEL-RULE4, ST-UI-OPEN and ST-T-FROZEN-1, ST-T-LABEL-RULE4-1, ST-T-AUDIT-3. Numbers: docs/status/audit-2026-10-17.md.

Morning hand-over (2026-10-17, 03:11-03:30): every status checked against a clean run of tools/check.py (OK in 523 s: adapters 97, core 7,354 + 4 skipped, plan 529, scene 42, server 91, verify 117 + 1 strict xfail, studio build + vitest 44, e2e 47) and --trace (missing 0). Set from what is built: ST-EXP-3MF and ST-T-EXP-2 (M6a's beds 3MF and M8c's Send project), ST-EXP-STL (the bundle's oriented parts/ STLs), ST-UI-EXPORT (Sticker sheet…, Print…, Send to PrusaSlicer…); ST-T-FUSION-M7-1 added as planned (M7, Fusion). The record: docs/STATUS.md and reports/status.html (with reports/screens/morning_*.png).
